pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { pdfPageCount } from "@xberg-io/xberg-wasm";
function main() {
  const _pdf_bytes_content = await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("this is not a pdf document");
try {
    pdfPageCount(_pdf_bytes_content);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(String(error));
  }
}
```
